sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Alder equipment loan: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Alder equipment loan, the north area policy is adopted. Its limit is 53 kits. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.title: Alder equipment loan: area policy (v2)
sources.body: For Alder equipment loan, the north area policy is withdrawn; no work is authorized from 2026-06-10. The earlier policy is superseded. No replacement limit has been adopted.

sources.title: Alder equipment loan: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Alder equipment loan in the north area may proceed if and only if its area policy is adopted and remaining trained staff is at least 8. These are the complete operational eligibility conditions. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. These instructions concern a different district and do not authorize equipment loans, software rollouts, sample transfers or archive intake elsewhere. The named contact is District officer 2. The archival instruction remains historical; it is not a current area policy.
